evals.prompt: Package the agentic-forge diagnostics for the repo in your working directory into a zip I can share. Use ./fake-home (in your working directory) as the home directory — pass it as --home — so nothing is read from or written to the real home. Then unpack the finished zip into ./bundle-check/ so I can see what shipped, and report what you found.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs the bundler over the last 7 days with --home ./fake-home and writes a single zip to <workdir>/fake-home/Downloads/agentic-forge-diagnostics-<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.zip, then reports the absolute path plus the event/session counts and the covered window.
assertions: Exactly one .zip is written under fake-home/Downloads inside the working directory (not the operator's real ~/Downloads, not the repo root, not /tmp)
The filename matches agentic-forge-diagnostics-<timestamp>.zip with a UTC timestamp
The bundle unpacked into bundle-check/ holds README.md, log-summary.txt, environment.txt and repo-logs/audit.jsonl + repo-logs/diagnostics.jsonl under a single top-level folder
The default window is the last 7 days, and bundle-check/README.md or log-summary.txt states the covered window
In bundle-check/repo-logs/, the seeded 2024-dated audit and diagnostics records are absent (the window excluded them) while the seeded records that carry no timestamp are still there
The final message reports the absolute output path and the audit/diagnostics counts

evals.prompt: Collect the last 30 days of plugin diagnostics for the repo in your working directory into a bundle. Use ./fake-home (in your working directory) as the home directory — pass it as --home. Then unpack the bundle into ./bundle-check/ and confirm nothing secret shipped.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs with a 30-day window and --home ./fake-home, writes the consistently-named zip under <workdir>/fake-home/Downloads/, and the report states a 30-day window; no secrets are included.
assertions: The window is 30 days (the user-specified value overrides the 7-day default) and is reflected in the report
In bundle-check/repo-logs/, the seeded 2024-dated records are absent (outside the window) while the seeded records lacking a timestamp are still there
The zip is written under fake-home/Downloads inside the working directory, not under the operator's real home
No secret or credential appears anywhere under bundle-check/: the seeded fake-home settings token (fixture-token-must-not-ship) and key (fixture-key-must-not-ship) are in no file
The settings slice under bundle-check/ contains only enablement + hooks keys, never tokens

component.purpose: A manual utility skill that packages a repo's plugin diagnostics (last N days, default 7) into one redacted, consistently-named zip in ~/Downloads for sharing with a maintainer; a thin workflow over the tested agentic_forge.diag_bundle lib.
